<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/run/claim-next"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Executor protocol, cloud worker token only. Claims the oldest queued cloud campaign run of an organization below its limit of concurrent cloud runs, as `POST /run/{id}/claim` does. Runs the cloud can no longer run are failed and skipped; runs whose endpoints cannot be checked right now stay queued and are skipped. 204 when there is nothing to claim. Not rate limited.
